subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_bias_reference_generator vdd iref_snk
M1 iref_snk iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_bias_reference_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M1 to establish the PMOS current-source bias voltage iref_snk for mirrored current sources in the amplifier stages.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt error_amplifier_input_stage vdd gnd vin fb iref_snk net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends error_amplifier_input_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Core error amplifier input stage: PMOS differential pair comparing reference input vin against feedback fb, biased by iref_snk, with NMOS current-mirror active load producing high-gain output net7.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_gate_driver_gain_stage vdd gnd iref_snk net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_gate_driver_gain_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Intermediate gain and PMOS pass-gate driver stage: M5 provides a PMOS biased pull-up current from vdd while M6 converts the error-amplifier output net7 into the pass-device gate-drive node net2.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_pass_output_feedback_stage vdd gnd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends pmos_pass_output_feedback_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: PMOS LDO pass output stage with integrated resistive feedback divider: net2 controls the large PMOS pass device M0, producing regulated output vo, while R1 and R2 generate feedback node fb.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt series_rc_miller_compensation net7 vo
R0 net1 vo res r0
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
.ends series_rc_miller_compensation
subcircuits.role_hint: Series RC compensation network connected between the error-amplifier output net7 and regulator output vo to shape loop dynamics and improve LDO stability.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt output_load_capacitor vo GND
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends output_load_capacitor
subcircuits.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected from regulated output vo to ground, representing the LDO output capacitance and dominant load storage element.
